name: EPIC 251616662
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 17, 7.3 solar radii and 1.01 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,367 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 1.01 solar masses and 7.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,787 K at its surface.
